games.name: Medieval Fantasy RPG
games.desc:
EARLY PUBLIC TESTING RELEASE (Upcoming inventory wipe soon)

Welcome to Grothmar Valley, a medieval fantasy RPG currently in active development. This is an early public testing release focused on core gameplay and gathering community feedback.

Explore the world, roleplay with others, create or join factions, fight for territory, and build your own stories and adventures.

Current State:
⚔️ Basic faction systems and territory gameplay
🧭 Exploration and roleplay-focused gameplay
🛠️ Core systems are still being developed
🚧 Many RPG features, mechanics, creatures, and content are not yet implemented

Important:
⚠️ Progress is temporary. A major inventory/data wipe will occur in a future update as development continues.

Your feedback, support, and 👍 likes help shape the future of Grothmar Valley.
